chrome.timer_locked_tip: The timer stays visible for the last 5 minutes.
chrome.directions_timer_note: The timer keeps running while this window is open.
Bu oyna ochiq turganda ham vaqt yuradi.
precheck.title: Before you start
Boshlashdan oldin
precheck.nothing_started: Nothing has started yet — the timer is not running.
Hali hech narsa boshlanmadi, vaqt yurmayapti.
precheck.subtitle: Check your headphones, microphone and connection. Take your time.
Naushnik, mikrofon va internetni tekshiring. Shoshilmang.
precheck.lang_note: Exam buttons are in English, like in the real exam.
precheck.headphones_body: Put on your headphones and press Play sample. Adjust the volume until the voice is clear.
Naushnikni taqing va "Namunani eshitish"ni bosing. Ovoz aniq eshitilguncha balandligini sozlang.
precheck.mic_body: Press Record 5 s, say one sentence, then play it back.
"5 soniya yozish"ni bosing, bitta jumla ayting, keyin eshitib ko'ring.
precheck.mic_permission: Your browser will ask for microphone access. Choose Allow.
Brauzer mikrofonga ruxsat so'raydi. "Ruxsat berish"ni tanlang.
precheck.mic_quiet_room: Speaking is recorded. A quiet place makes the recording clearer.
Speaking yoziladi. Tinch joyda yozuv aniqroq chiqadi.
precheck.conn_weak: Slow connection. You can still start — answers are saved on this device and sent when the connection improves.
Ulanish sekin. Baribir boshlashingiz mumkin — javoblar shu qurilmada saqlanadi va ulanish yaxshilanganda yuboriladi.
precheck.conn_offline: No connection. Connect to the internet, then press Check again.
Internet yo'q. Internetga ulaning, keyin "Qayta tekshirish"ni bosing.
precheck.fullscreen_body: The exam opens in fullscreen to help you focus.
Diqqatingiz chalg'imasligi uchun imtihon to'liq ekranda ochiladi.
precheck.ime_body: Switch your keyboard to Chinese (Pinyin) and type 你好 in the box.
Klaviaturani xitoycha (Pinyin) ga o'tkazing va maydonga 你好 deb yozing.
precheck.ime_help_title: How to turn on Chinese input
precheck.ime_help_win: Windows: Settings → Time & language → Language → Add Chinese (Simplified). Switch with Win + Space.
Windows: Sozlamalar → Vaqt va til → Til → Xitoy (soddalashtirilgan) qo'shing. Win + Space bilan almashtiring.
precheck.ime_help_mac: macOS: System Settings → Keyboard → Input Sources → add Pinyin – Simplified. Switch with Ctrl + Space.
macOS: Tizim sozlamalari → Klaviatura → Kiritish manbalari → Pinyin – Simplified qo'shing. Ctrl + Space bilan almashtiring.
precheck.ime_fullscreen_note: The Chinese input window won't take you out of fullscreen.
Xitoycha yozish oynasi to'liq ekrandan chiqarib yubormaydi.
precheck.try_body: 2 minutes · 3 practice questions, a short audio and a 10-second recording. Not scored.
2 daqiqa · 3 ta mashq savoli, qisqa audio va 10 soniyalik yozuv. Baholanmaydi.
precheck.try_bar: Practice mode — not scored. The real exam timer has not started.
Mashq rejimi — baholanmaydi. Imtihon vaqti hali boshlanmagan.
precheck.try_done: That's how it works. You're ready when you are.
Hammasi shunday ishlaydi. Tayyor bo'lsangiz, boshlang.
precheck.audio_only_toggle: Exam mode: questions as audio only
precheck.audio_only_hint: Like the real IELTS Speaking test — question text will not appear on screen.
Haqiqiy IELTS Speaking'dagidek — savol matni ekranda chiqmaydi.
precheck.rule_timer: Each section has its own timer. It keeps running even if you close the browser.
Har bo'limning o'z taymeri bor. Brauzer yopilsa ham vaqt yuraveradi.
precheck.rule_lock: After you finish a section, you can't go back to it.
precheck.rule_autosave: Your answers save automatically, even if the internet drops.
Javoblaringiz avtomatik saqlanadi, internet uzilsa ham.
precheck.rule_exits: Leaving fullscreen or switching tabs is noted in your report. It doesn't stop the exam.
To'liq ekrandan chiqish yoki boshqa oynaga o'tish hisobotda qayd etiladi. Imtihonni to'xtatmaydi.
precheck.rule_ielts: IELTS-format mock · Listening audio plays once · Writing has no spellcheck.
IELTS formatidagi mock · Listening audiosi bir marta eshittiriladi · Writing'da imlo tekshiruvi yo'q.
precheck.rule_cefr: CEFR-format practice test: structure, timing and the 75-point scale follow the official format; the interface is not official and not linked to UZBMB. Each recording plays twice.
CEFR formatidagi mashq testi: tuzilma, vaqt va 75 ballik shkala rasmiyga mos; interfeys rasmiy emas va UZBMB bilan bog'liq emas. Har yozuv ikki marta eshittiriladi.
precheck.rule_sat: Digital SAT-format mock · 2 modules per section · 10-minute break between sections · Calculator in Math.
Digital SAT formatidagi mock · har bo'limda 2 modul · bo'limlar orasida 10 daqiqa tanaffus · Math'da kalkulyator bor.
precheck.rule_toefl: TOEFL iBT-format mock · In Listening you can't go back to earlier questions · Each Writing and Speaking task has its own timer.
TOEFL iBT formatidagi mock · Listening'da oldingi savollarga qaytib bo'lmaydi · Writing va Speaking'da har topshiriqning o'z taymeri bor.
precheck.rule_hsk: HSK-format mock · Answers are typed with Chinese (Pinyin) input · Listening plays {n} time(s).
HSK formatidagi mock · Javoblar xitoycha (Pinyin) klaviaturada yoziladi · Listening {n} marta eshittiriladi.
precheck.cta_hint: Finish the checks above to start
intro.scoring_ai: Scored by AI · a teacher checks when needed
AI baholaydi · kerak bo'lsa o'qituvchi tekshiradi
intro.timer_note: The timer starts when you press Start.
intro.plays_once: Audio plays once · no pause or replay
Audio bir marta · pauza va qaytarish yo'q
intro.cefr_typed: In the official exam Writing is handwritten; here you type.
Rasmiy imtihonda Writing qo'lda yoziladi, bu yerda klaviaturada yozasiz.
intro.speaking_later: You can take Speaking now or later, in a quiet room.
Speaking'ni hozir yoki keyinroq, tinch xonada topshirishingiz mumkin.
intro.break_body: Stand up, drink some water. When the break ends, you'll continue to Math.
O'rningizdan turing, suv iching. Tanaffus tugagach Math bo'limiga o'tasiz.
timeup.title: Time's up.
Vaqt tugadi.
timeup.writing_saved: Your text was saved exactly as written.
timeup.last: That was the last section. Your results are being prepared.
Bu oxirgi bo'lim edi. Natijalaringiz tayyorlanmoqda.
banner.offline: Reconnecting… Your answers are saved on this device. Keep going.
Ulanish tiklanmoqda… Javoblaringiz shu qurilmada saqlangan. Davom etavering.
banner.offline_long: Still reconnecting. The timer continues on the server — your answers are safe on this device.
Ulanish hali tiklanmoqda. Vaqt server bo'yicha davom etmoqda — javoblaringiz shu qurilmada saqlangan.
banner.fullscreen_exited: You left fullscreen. The exam continues and the timer is running.
Siz to'liq ekrandan chiqdingiz. Imtihon davom etmoqda, vaqt yuribdi.
banner.tab_noted: Switching away was noted. Your exam continues.
Boshqa oynaga o'tish qayd etildi. Imtihon davom etmoqda.
banner.audio_loading: Loading audio… {p}% — your time isn't running yet.
banner.audio_failed: The audio didn't load — this is on our side. Your time isn't running.
Audio yuklanmadi — bu bizning tomondagi muammo. Vaqtingiz ketmayapti.
banner.audio_report_skip_note: This part will be marked as a technical issue, not as wrong answers. Your center will see the report.
Bu qism texnik nosozlik deb belgilanadi, xato javob sifatida emas. Markazingiz xabarni ko'radi.
banner.mic_silent: We can't hear you — check your microphone
banner.recording_queued: Your recording is saved on this device and will upload when the connection returns.
Yozuvingiz shu qurilmada saqlandi, ulanish tiklanganda yuboriladi.
listening.prep: Part {p} · Audio starts in {t} — read questions {a}–{b}
listening.plays_once: Plays once · no pause or replay
Bir marta · pauza va qaytarish yo'q
listening.all_finished: All recordings finished — check your answers · {t} left
Barcha yozuvlar tugadi — javoblarni tekshiring · {t} qoldi
listening.questions_after: Listen carefully. Questions appear after the recording.
Diqqat bilan tinglang. Savollar yozuvdan keyin chiqadi.
writing.footer: Spellcheck off · paste disabled · autosaved {s} s ago
Imlo tekshiruvi o'chiq · tashqaridan qo'yish o'chiq · {s} soniya oldin saqlandi
writing.paste_blocked: Pasting from outside the exam is turned off.
writing.hsk_text_hidden: The text is now hidden. Write your summary.
Matn yashirildi. Endi qisqa bayonni yozing.
speaking.cant_hear: We can't hear you — check your microphone
finish.title: Finish {section}?
{section} bo'limini tugatasizmi?
finish.chip_hint: Click a number to go to that question.
finish.no_return: After finishing you can't return to this section.
finish.next_task_body: You can't come back to this task. You still have {t}.
Bu topshiriqqa qaytib bo'lmaydi. Vaqt hali bor: {t}.
resume.title: Welcome back
Xush kelibsiz
resume.body: Your exam continues where you left off.
resume.timer_note: The timer kept running on the server while you were away.
Siz yo'qligingizda vaqt server bo'yicha davom etdi.
resume.audio_note: Audio continues from where it is now; missed parts are not replayed.
Audio hozirgi joyidan davom etadi; o'tib ketgan qism qayta eshittirilmaydi.
resume.time_ended: Time for {section} ended while you were away. Your saved answers were submitted.
Siz yo'qligingizda {section} bo'limi vaqti tugadi. Saqlangan javoblaringiz topshirildi.
results.grading_writing: Writing is being graded — usually a few minutes.
Writing baholanmoqda — odatda bir necha daqiqa.
results.grading_speaking: Speaking is being graded — usually 5–15 min, up to 1 hour at peak times.
Speaking baholanmoqda — odatda 5–15 daqiqa, band paytlarda 1 soatgacha.
results.can_leave: You can leave — we'll notify you when it's ready.
Chiqib ketishingiz mumkin — tayyor bo'lgach xabar beramiz.
results.others_ready: Your other results are ready below.
results.human_review: A teacher is double-checking this score (up to 24 h). Your other results are ready.
Bu ballni o'qituvchi qayta tekshirmoqda (24 soatgacha). Qolgan natijalar tayyor.
results.delayed: Grading is taking longer than usual. We'll notify you when it's ready — nothing you need to do.
Baholash odatdagidan uzoqroq davom etmoqda. Tayyor bo'lgach xabar beramiz — sizdan hech narsa talab qilinmaydi.
results.no_response: No response for this task — no score yet.
Bu topshiriqqa javob yo'q — hozircha ball yo'q.
results.transcript_note: Automatic transcript — it may contain small errors.
Avtomatik matn — kichik xatolar bo'lishi mumkin.
results.no_overall: The overall band needs all four skills. Take Speaking to see it.
Umumiy band uchun to'rtala ko'nikma kerak. Ko'rish uchun Speaking'ni topshiring.
results.disclaimer: Practice result — not an official certificate.
results.trend_empty: Complete another mock to see your progress.
Natija dinamikasini ko'rish uchun yana bir mock topshiring.
gate.title: Mock exams work on a computer only
Mock imtihonlar faqat kompyuterda ishlaydi
gate.body_mobile: Open this link on a laptop or desktop computer.
Bu havolani noutbuk yoki kompyuterda oching.
gate.body_narrow: The window is too narrow. Maximize the browser window or zoom out (Ctrl and −).
Oyna juda tor. Brauzer oynasini kattalashtiring yoki kichraytiring (Ctrl va −).
gate.mid_attempt: The timer keeps running. Widen the window to continue — your answers are saved.
Vaqt yurmoqda. Davom etish uchun oynani kengaytiring — javoblaringiz saqlangan.
errors.mic_denied: Microphone access is off. Click the lock icon in the address bar → Microphone → Allow, then "Check again".
Mikrofonga ruxsat berilmagan. Manzil qatoridagi qulf belgisini bosing → Mikrofon → Ruxsat berish, keyin "Qayta tekshirish".
errors.mic_not_found: No microphone found. Plug in headphones with a microphone, then "Check again".
Mikrofon topilmadi. Mikrofonli naushnikni ulang, keyin "Qayta tekshirish".
errors.no_sound: No sound yet. Check your headphones and system volume, then "Play again".
Ovoz eshitilmayapti. Naushnikni va kompyuter ovozini tekshiring, keyin "Qayta eshitish".
errors.browser_unsupported: This browser can't record audio. Please open the exam in the latest Chrome or Edge.
Bu brauzer ovoz yoza olmaydi. Imtihonni Chrome yoki Edge'ning so'nggi versiyasida oching.
errors.media_failed: Could not load the audio — this is on our side, your time isn't running.
Audio yuklanmadi — bu bizning tomondagi muammo, vaqtingiz ketmayapti.
errors.report_sent: Report sent. Your center can see it.
Xabar yuborildi. Markazingiz uni ko'ra oladi.
errors.insufficient_balance: This mock isn't available on your account yet. Ask your center to add it.
Bu mock hisobingizda hali mavjud emas. Markazingizdan qo'shib berishni so'rang.
errors.insufficient_balance_center: Not enough balance: this costs {price} so'm, available {balance} so'm. Top up to continue.
Balans yetarli emas: narxi {price} so'm, mavjud {balance} so'm. Davom etish uchun hisobni to'ldiring.
errors.window_not_open: Bu mock {date} kuni soat {time} da ochiladi.
errors.window_closed: The time window for this mock ended on {date} at {time}. Ask your center for a new one.
Bu mock muddati {date} kuni soat {time} da tugagan. Markazingizdan yangisini so'rang.
errors.attempt_locked: This attempt is already submitted. Your results are on the results page.
Bu urinish allaqachon topshirilgan. Natijalaringiz natijalar sahifasida.
errors.stage_locked: This section's time has ended. Your saved answers were submitted.
Bu bo'lim vaqti tugadi. Saqlangan javoblaringiz topshirildi.
errors.session_expired: Your session ended. Sign in again — the exam will continue where you left off.
Sessiya tugadi. Qayta kiring — imtihon to'xtagan joyidan davom etadi.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Your answers are saved. Try again in a moment.
Bizning tomonda nosozlik yuz berdi. Javoblaringiz saqlangan. Birozdan keyin qayta urinib ko'ring.
hub.no_overall_v1: The overall band is calculated together with Speaking — Speaking is coming soon.
Umumiy band Speaking bilan birga hisoblanadi — Speaking tez orada qo'shiladi.
hub.self_practice_off: Self-practice isn't available yet. You'll start in the session your center assigns.
Mustaqil mashq hozircha yo'q. Markaz tayinlagan sessiyada boshlaysiz.
hub.start_body_assigned: Your center covers this mock. The device check comes first — the timer starts after it.
To'lovni markaz qiladi. Avval qurilma tekshiruvi — vaqt undan keyin boshlanadi.
hub.repeat_variant_note: You've done all variants. On a repeated variant your score may not show your real level — the questions will be familiar.
Barcha variantlarni ishlagansiz. Takroriy variantda natija darajangizni aniq ko'rsatmasligi mumkin — savollar tanish bo'ladi.
hub.active_attempt: You have an unfinished attempt: {section}, {t} left.
hub.start_failed: Couldn't start — try again. Nothing was charged.
Boshlab bo'lmadi — qayta urinib ko'ring. Hech narsa yechilmadi.
hub.code_mismatch: The code or name doesn't match. Check the spelling or ask your center's administrator for the code again.
Kod yoki ism mos kelmadi. Yozilishini tekshiring yoki kodni markaz administratoridan qayta so'rang.
hub.too_many_tries: Too many attempts. Try again in {s} s.
Urinishlar ko'p bo'ldi. {s} soniyadan keyin qayta urinib ko'ring.
precheck.tour_timer: Time left. You can hide it — it comes back for the last 5 minutes.
Qolgan vaqt. Yashirish mumkin — oxirgi 5 daqiqada qaytib chiqadi.
precheck.tour_navigator: Question numbers. Dark means answered. Click a number to jump to it.
Savol raqamlari. To'q rang — javob berilgan. Raqamni bossangiz, o'sha savolga o'tasiz.
precheck.tour_flag: Not sure? Flag the question and come back to it later.
Ishonchingiz komil emasmi? Savolni belgilab, keyin qayting.
precheck.tour_finish: Finish section always asks first and shows what's unanswered.
"Finish section" doim avval so'raydi va javobsiz savollarni ko'rsatadi.
